videos.title: TV Static, Buzzing Sounds & Pulsing White Noise
videos.description: I tried to recreate the sounds I hear every minute of every day because of my tinnitus. My tinnitus is a mixture of TV static, electrical buzzing, white noise, a softer high-pitched ringing tone in the background, and subtle pulsations. At times, the buzzing reminds me of the electrical sounds near high-voltage power lines. I hear different sounds in each ear, with a stronger and more complex buzzing sensation in my left ear.
